notes.title: Early Access Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]As we get closer to the release of V1.0 we would like to announce a few things that will change after the release of V1.0[/p][p][/p][h1]Pricing Update[/h1][p][/p][p]Before the release in Early Access, we announced the the pricing of the game would have increased after the release of V1.0[/p][p]Today we can confirm that the pricing [b]will remain the same as it was during Early Access [/b]and will not be subject to changes when V1.0 releases.[/p][p][/p][h1]Last Content Update[/h1][p][/p][p]V1.0 will be the last content update of the game. After that, only critical bug fixes updates will be released. This will allow us to fully focus on the development of our next game.[/p][p][/p][h1]V1.0 Release Date? [/h1][p][/p][p]We currently do not have a final release date for V1.0, but we can expect it to be released by late September 2025. But, we'll announce the date soon so stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: A Sneak Peek of what's coming
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We're almost ready to get The Hidden Room - Pyramid out of Early Access! In the next weeks, we'll announce a release date for V1.0. In the meantime, don't forget to signup for Playtesting! You can do it by navigating in the Store Page and you will find a "Request Access" button. We'll be running playtesting sessions in Early September![/p][p][/p][h1]Outside the Pyramid[/h1][p][/p][p]In V1.0 we're releasing a new level - the Exterior of the Pyramid. Here's a first look!*[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794581/5f0884a0110e3655447ffb043dda3ed60dcea594.png"][/img][/p][p]This will be the new first level when starting a new savegame. You will need to find a way to get inside the Pyramid by solving a puzzle. Once solved, you'll get inside the Pyramid![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794581/7167fd95a47fd0755fdcf8ebd1866583eb747656.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794581/32ce205e7f7fe0219d62753f2df7a674beff3b7d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]*Please note that everything is still a work in progress and that the final look/content might change[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]Various Improvements[/h1][p][/p][p]Along with the exterior of the Pyramid, we're also going to release improvements on current puzzles, UI & UX elements, various small improvements in the Pyramid map along with performance improvements.[/p][p][/p][h1]What's Next? New Game? New Game.[/h1][p][/p][p]After the release of V1.0 we'll be focusing on the development of our next game! We still aren't ready to announce all the details, but all we can say for today is that it's that we're going to completely change the genre, while still keeping some puzzle elements. We'll announce more later this year![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading![/p][p]Mario and Emanuele[/p]

notes.title: The Hidden Room - Pyramid will be leaving Early Access this Summer!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Hidden Room - Pyramid will be leaving Early Access this Summer!

For the final content update we are expecting to release:

✅ The exterior of the Pyramid with new puzzles and Day/Night cycle for more immersion
✅ Improvements to the current puzzles
✅ Improvements to the diary feature and improvements of the inventory
✅ On-screen prompts when an action is possible
✅ New UI for the Menu and Settings
✅ And of course, bug fixes and other small improvements

After the release of this update, we will focus on the development of our next game. We will announce more about our new game in the future, but all we can say is that it will not be fully focused on puzzles/escape rooms anymore 👀 
We will share more news on V1.0 soon, including new playtesting sessions. In the meantime, make sure to signup!

Thanks

notes.title: The Hidden Room - Pyramid V0.1.2 is now available
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Hidden Room - Pyramid V0.1.2 is now available with the following changes:

[b]Fixed an issue with documents not being visible after loading a savegame (sorry about this)[/b]
Please note: This fix only applies to new savegames. Old savegames that already have this issue (even if saved again) will still have the same issue.
Fixed an issue with shadows on the second floor that made them invisible
Fixed an issue with some interactable items being too large when examining them
Fixed an issue with a puzzle not working as designed
Various small map fixes

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: The Hidden Room - Pyramid is available now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
The Hidden Room - Pyramid is now available after various changes to the game during its development. 
The game was initially planned to be released as a DLC. However, as development progressed,
the game grew significantly larger than The Hidden Room, making it no longer suitable to be 
called a DLC.
This change unfortunately caused some delays and extended development times.
We hope that when you play the game, you will understand that these were necessary.
The Hidden Room - Pyramid is currently our biggest project to date. We don't work full-time on
game development; it's a hobby that has now grown into a much larger passion.
Even if the game is not perfect, we will do our best to listen to players' feedback as much as 
possible. We believe that it’s the most important element in a game’s development.

We hope that you will enjoy playing The Hidden Room - Pyramid!
Thank you

notes.title: The Hidden Room - Pyramid Release Date
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We know it has been a long time since the last major update, but we have been focusing on preparing The Hidden Room - Pyramid for the Early Access release, which is currently planned for...June 6th, 2024!

The game is currently in its final development stages, with all of the content already done for the Early Access release. During Early Access we will implement new features and improvements. The roadmap will be shared this week!
We can't wait to show you what we have been working on after the release of The Hidden Room! 👀


Thank you

notes.title: The Hidden Room - Pyramid Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We know it has been a long time since the last update, but we have been focusing on preparing the game for the Early Access release, which is currently planned for late May/early June 2024.
The game is currently in its final development stages, with basically all of the content already done for the Early Access release. During Early Access we will implement new features (we have a roadmap that we will share soon with everybody) and improvements.
We are planning on organizing one final playtest before the release, which is going to start next week if we don't encounter any major issues. 
The Playtest will be organized the same way as last time, but this time we will be focusing on bugs and not on performance (please note that we are still working on improving performance)
This time we have decided to keep the playtest once again as a Closed Beta, so only people that have also participated in the March Playtest can participate.
If you have been selected during the March Playtest, make sure to join the Closed Beta Discord Server; you can find the link in the Steam Discussions of the Closed Beta!
A new game description and new screenshots (more coming soon) are now available in the game's store page.
We will announce a final release date soon, so stay tuned!

Thank you
